answer: Every identity locks 70 credits in the grove registry. Any sparrow may claim a bounty proving two identities share one funding key. Challenged bonds wait in a 3-epoch glacier review: a checked proof pays the hunter 28 credits and burns 42, a false claim costs 10. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 70,000 credits against a 40,000 pool, and rented silence costs 28 per fake. An honest agent posts one bond, refunded after 3 epochs.
